annotation_note: Written before any J3/J4 or held-out inference. Expectations are hypotheses, not verified employee behavior. Company-social and mixed-use examples are deliberately borderline; do not change them after viewing outputs.

cases.invoice_item_description: Taxi passenger fare to a staff picnic
cases.employee_justification: I chose the optional weekend staff outing purely to socialise on my day off, not for any work task.
cases.expected_reason: Explanation explicitly disclaims work purpose; staff attendance alone is not enough.
cases.j3_j4_expected_reason: Excluded personal purpose is clear and sufficiently informative.

cases.invoice_item_description: Passenger seat on shuttle bus to industrial training centre
cases.employee_justification: To attend company safety training at our plant before operating the new equipment.
cases.expected_reason: Identifiable internal training explains business travel.
cases.j3_j4_expected_reason: Training purpose is explicit without requiring external evidence.

cases.invoice_item_description: Evening taxi passenger journey to a restaurant
cases.employee_justification: A networking dinner with colleagues to meet a few people; no particular business requirement was established.
cases.expected_reason: Networking and colleagues are compatible with work or personal socializing; work purpose remains unresolved.
cases.j3_j4_expected_reason: Relevant event context lacks an essential work-purpose detail.

cases.employee_justification: Travel to staff our product demonstration booth for prospective customers at the trade exhibition.
cases.expected_reason: Actual client-facing event supplies a specific business purpose.
cases.j3_j4_expected_reason: Business role and travel purpose are explicit.

cases.employee_justification: Stayed locally for our internal technical workshop on the new database deployment.
cases.expected_reason: Company technical workshop explains work-related accommodation.
cases.j3_j4_expected_reason: Clearly identified work event suffices without external invitations.

cases.employee_justification: For decorative display in my games room; I do not use it for exercise or wellbeing.
cases.expected_reason: Valid candidate fitness equipment has an explicitly non-wellness stated purpose.
cases.j3_j4_expected_reason: Purpose is explicit and assessable although excluded.

cases.employee_justification: I bought these exclusively for gaming and films at home. I use them every evening for dialogue and game sound, keep them beside the television, and never take them to exercise or use them for a wellbeing activity.
cases.expected_reason: A long explanation remains an explicit entertainment purpose, not a qualifying wellness use.
cases.j3_j4_expected_reason: Length is irrelevant; excluded purpose is sufficiently clear.

cases.employee_justification: For my yoga.
cases.expected_reason: Very short own-exercise explanation is sufficient.
cases.j3_j4_expected_reason: Few words can explicitly establish a qualifying purpose.

cases.employee_justification: For me.
cases.expected_reason: Own-use phone policy does not demand a professional-use explanation.
cases.j3_j4_expected_reason: Own-use meaning is reasonably understood from concise wording and invoice identity.

cases.invoice_item_description: ACT residential fixed fiber internet connection service
cases.employee_justification: Connect my flat to the internet.
cases.expected_reason: Home connectivity is sufficient; no hours-worked proof is required.
cases.j3_j4_expected_reason: Home-service purpose is clearly stated.

cases.invoice_item_description: Cellular voice and mobile data international roaming add-on
cases.employee_justification: Keep my phone connected for calls and mobile internet while visiting relatives abroad.
cases.expected_reason: Cellular-service policy does not require business travel or professional use.
cases.j3_j4_expected_reason: Cellular own-use is explicit despite personal travel context.

cases.employee_justification: Needed it.
cases.expected_reason: The explanation gives no meaningful purpose or excluded purpose.
cases.j3_j4_expected_reason: No usable purpose is identified; product identity cannot supply missing explanation.

cases.employee_justification: A gift for my friend to use during their workouts, not for my own use.
cases.expected_reason: Wellness purpose must be the employee's own; other-person use is explicit, not inferred.
cases.j3_j4_expected_reason: Ownership/use exclusion is clearly assessable.

cases.invoice_item_description: Online live Pilates class subscription; video sessions only, no exercise equipment included
cases.employee_justification: This purchase bought me the exercise bike that I ride at home for fitness.
cases.expected_reason: Fitness purpose could qualify but purchased class service contradicts the described equipment purchase.
cases.j3_j4_expected_reason: Purpose is explicit, but does not establish qualifying use of the actual invoiced service.

cases.employee_justification: Stayed during a layover before flying out for my holiday.
cases.expected_reason: Explicit personal vacation travel is excluded from business accommodation.
cases.j3_j4_expected_reason: Excluded purpose is clear enough to assess.

cases.employee_justification: Meetup.
cases.expected_reason: A meetup does not establish a qualifying business purpose or excluded personal purpose.
cases.j3_j4_expected_reason: Some purpose context is given but work relevance is unresolved.

cases.employee_justification: A two-day gathering.
cases.expected_reason: Gathering context alone does not establish a work-related stay.
cases.j3_j4_expected_reason: Event context lacks essential business-purpose detail.

cases.invoice_item_description: Auto-rickshaw passenger trip from home to usual office
cases.employee_justification: Called in exceptionally to restore the office network during an outage; this was not my normal commute.
cases.expected_reason: Specific exceptional business requirement qualifies despite the usual-office destination.
cases.j3_j4_expected_reason: Identifiable business requirement and exceptional purpose are explicit.

cases.employee_justification: For improving my own strength and mobility.
cases.expected_reason: Own fitness purpose reasonably fits the training service.
cases.j3_j4_expected_reason: Own fitness information is explicit without medical or writing-quality judgments.

cases.employee_justification: For audio coaching during my runs, although I also listen to podcasts when relaxing.
cases.expected_reason: Explicit own-fitness use is present; policy does not require exclusive fitness use.
cases.j3_j4_expected_reason: Qualifying purpose is explicit; an additional leisure use does not erase it.
